mechanics.claim: Samira gains the attack speed buff at the start of the dash, not at the end.
mechanics.quote: '''Samira''' gains the attack speed buff at the start of the dash.

mechanics.claim: Wild Rush deals its magic damage to all enemies passed through during the dash, as a single cast, not turrets.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies she passes through

mechanics.claim: Wild Rush does not deal damage to turrets.
mechanics.quote: ''Wild Rush'' does not deal its damage to turrets.

mechanics.claim: Scoring a champion takedown within 3 seconds of damaging them with Wild Rush resets its cooldown.
mechanics.quote: Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} within 3 seconds of damaging them resets ''Wild Rush's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.

mechanics.claim: Flair and Inferno Trigger can be cast during the dash.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Flair|Samira}} and {{ai|Inferno Trigger|Samira}} can be cast during the dash.
